safety_message_native: This is a gas boiler; a mistake can cause a gas leak or carbon monoxide poisoning. For your safety, I can't walk you through this. Please don't try it yourself — contact Vexa official support or your landlord. If you smell gas, open the windows, leave the room and call the gas emergency line (in the UK: 0800 111 999).
